note: The axis count is read from the HVAR item variation store in attacker-controlled font data.
The parsed axis count controls how many axis-coordinate records are allocated for each region.
There is no check that axisCount is bounded by the face's actual axis count before the parser trusts it for iteration.

code:
if ( FT_READ_SHORT( start ) ||
               FT_READ_SHORT( peak )  ||
               FT_READ_SHORT( end )   )
            goto Exit;
note: Each loop iteration reads three shorts for an axis record; an oversized axisCount drives reads past the end of the HVAR region list.
